steps.say: Chaliye, dekhte hain Python is program ko kaise chalata hai. Yaad rakhiye, Python ek baar mein ek line padhta hai, upar se neeche tak.
Pehli line hash sign se shuru hoti hai. Yeh ek comment hai. Comments insaanon ke liye notes hote hain. Python inhe bas chhod deta hai.
Ab Python print par pahunchta hai. Print ka matlab hai: ise screen par dikhao. Quotes ke andar likhe shabd bilkul waise hi dikhaye jaate hain, jaise likhe gaye hain.
Python agli line par jaata hai, aur dawa ka naam print karta hai. Dhyaan dijiye, har print ek nayi line par shuru hota hai.
Yahan print mein teen items hain, jo commas se alag kiye gaye hain. Python inhe ek ke baad ek dikhata hai, aur har item ke beech ek space lagata hai.
Is line mein ek chhoti si calculation hai. Python pehle paanch sau guna teen karta hai, jo pandrah sau hota hai, aur phir answer print karta hai. Star sign ka matlab hai multiply, yaani guna.
Bas, itna hi! Python ne chaar instructions, kram se, upar se neeche tak chalaye. Aapne abhi-abhi apna pehla program samajh liya hai.

walkthrough.intro: Yeh raha aapka pehla program. Python ise line by line chalayega.

keyTerms.meaning: Insaanon ke liye ek note; Python ise ignore karta hai.
Text ya numbers ko screen par dikhata hai.
Quotes ke andar ka text, bilkul waisa hi dikhaya jaata hai jaisa likha hai.

steps.say: Prescription nirdeshon ki ek list hoti hai, jo kram se likhi jaati hai.
Pharmacist ise line by line padhta hai, upar se neeche tak.
Python program bhi nirdeshon ki ek list hai, jo kram se likhi jaati hai.
Interpreter pehli line padhta hai, aur dawa ka naam dikhata hai.
Phir woh agli line par jaata hai, aur strength dikhata hai.
Aakhri line par, woh paanch sau guna teen calculate karta hai, aur pandrah sau dikhata hai.
Bilkul prescription jaisa: ek baar mein ek line, upar se neeche tak. Har Python program aise hi chalta hai.

hook.title: Aapka pehla program, sirf 10 minute mein
hook.md:
Is lesson ke end tak aap apna **pehla Python program** likhenge aur chalayenge: ek chhota sa medicine label, jo dawa ka naam, uski strength aur poore din ki dose print karta hai.

Koi installation nahi. Coding ka koi background nahi chahiye. Bas aapka phone.

learn: Pharmacy students **Python** hi kyun seekh rahe hain
Python ek **program kaise chalata hai**, line by line, upar se neeche tak

explanation.heading: Program kya hai?
explanation.md: Ek **prescription** ke baare mein sochiye. Yeh saaf nirdeshon ki ek list hai, jo kram se likhi hoti hai:
explanation.quote: Paracetamol 500 mg ki 1 tablet, din mein teen baar, khaane ke baad lein.
explanation.mdAfter:
Patient in nirdeshon ko step by step follow karta hai.

Ek **program** bhi bilkul yahi hai, bas computer ke liye. Yeh nirdeshon ki ek list hai, jo kram se likhi hoti hai, aur computer inhe bilkul waise hi follow karta hai.

explanation.heading: Programming language kya hai?
explanation.md:
Computer English nahi samajhta. **Programming language** ek khaas bhasha hai, jise insaan aur computer dono samajh sakte hain. Hum isme nirdesh likhte hain, aur computer unhe poora karta hai.

Kai programming languages hain: C, Java, JavaScript, aur **Python**.

explanation.heading: Python hi kyun?
explanation.md:
Python ko **Guido van Rossum** ne banaya tha aur yeh pehli baar **1991** mein release hui. Aaj yeh duniya ki sabse popular languages mein se ek hai, aur aapke syllabus ke liye ise isliye chuna gaya kyunki:

- **Yeh lagbhag English jaisi padhi jaati hai**, isliye beginners ke liye aasaan hai.
- **Yeh sabke liye free hai.**
- **Isme data, graphs aur science ke liye ready-made toolkits (libraries) hain.**
- **Pharmacy aur healthcare mein iska bahut use hota hai**: clinical trial data analyse karna, drug concentration curves banana, adverse drug reaction (ADR) reports study karna, aur computer par nayi dawaiyan design karna.

explanation.heading: Python ek program kaise chalata hai?
explanation.md:
Sochiye, ek pharmacist prescription padh raha hai. Woh **pehli line, phir agli, phir agli** padhta hai, kram se, aur har line par kaam karta hai.

Python bhi aise hi kaam karta hai. **Interpreter** naam ka ek khaas program aapka code padhta hai aur use **ek baar mein ek line, upar se neeche tak** chalata hai.

callout.title: Interpreter
callout.md: Python ka woh hissa jo aapka code padhta hai aur har instruction ko poora karta hai.

errors.intro: Galtiyan hona normal hai. Python aapko saaf batata hai ki woh kahan atka.

examples.title: Python us line par ruk jaata hai jo use samajh nahi aati
examples.md: Python ne line 1 sahi se chala di. Line 2 par use `weight` shabd mila, lekin kisi ne Python ko nahi bataya tha ki `weight` ka matlab kya hai. Isliye woh ruk gaya, bilkul us pharmacist ki tarah jo prescription ki kisi unclear line par ruk jaata hai. Line 3 kabhi chali hi nahi.

examples.title: Ek missing bracket sab kuch rok deta hai
examples.md: Yahan **kuch bhi** print nahi hota, Line 1 bhi nahi. Kuch bhi chalane se pehle Python jaldi se check karta hai ki poora program sahi likha hai ya nahi. Missing bracket ek likhne ki galti hai (**syntax error**), isliye Python shuru hi nahi karta.

callout.title: Syntax
callout.md: Kisi programming language ke grammar ke niyam.

mistakes.fix: Python case-sensitive hai. `print` hamesha small letters mein likhein.

mistakes.mistake: WhatsApp ya Word se code copy karna, jisme tedhe quotes “ ” hote hain
mistakes.fix: Seedhe quotes " " use karein. Editor mein quotes khud type karein.

mistakes.mistake: Line ki shuruaat mein spaces daal dena
mistakes.fix: Abhi ke liye, har line bilkul left side se shuru karein.

mistakes.mistake: Text ke chaaron taraf quotes bhool jaana, jaise `print(Paracetamol)`
mistakes.fix: Text ko quotes ke andar rakhein: `print("Paracetamol")`.

hints: print() use karein, aur sentence ko quotes ke andar rakhein.

tasks.title: Ek medicine label banaiye
tasks.md: Ek program likhiye jo yeh label print kare. Daily dose (250 × 4) Python se **calculate** karwaiye; 1000 khud type mat kijiye.
hints: Har line ke liye ek print() use karein.
Strength wali line ke liye try karein: print("Strength  :", 250, "mg").

tasks.title: Bug dhoondhiye
tasks.md: Is program mein ek galti hai. Ise theek kijiye taaki yeh `Drug: Amoxicillin` print kare.

quiz.why: Python ko Guido van Rossum ne banaya; yeh pehli baar 1991 mein release hui.

quiz.q: Python kisi program ki lines ko kis kram mein chalata hai?
options: Upar se neeche, ek baar mein ek line
quiz.why: Interpreter code ko upar se neeche, ek baar mein ek line chalata hai.

quiz.q: Kaunsi line screen par Hello sahi se dikhati hai?
quiz.why: print small letters mein hona chahiye, aur text quotes ke andar hona chahiye.

quiz.q: Jo line # se shuru hoti hai, woh hai:
options: Comment, jise Python ignore karta hai
quiz.why: Comments insaanon ke liye notes hain; Python inhe chhod deta hai.
Python pehle 2 × 250 = 500 calculate karta hai, aur print har item ke beech space lagata hai.

exam.note: University exam English mein likha jaata hai, isliye model answers English mein hi rakhe gaye hain. Yeh practice ke liye important questions hain; asli university questions alag ho sakte hain.

children.label: Data aur graphs ke liye libraries

summary: **Program** nirdeshon ki ek list hai, jise computer kram se follow karta hai, bilkul prescription ki tarah.
**Python** ek free aur padhne mein aasaan programming language hai, jiska pharmacy aur healthcare mein bahut use hota hai.
**Interpreter** Python code ko **ek baar mein ek line, upar se neeche tak** chalata hai.
**print()** text aur numbers ko screen par dikhata hai; **#** se comment shuru hota hai.
**Errors** saaf batate hain ki Python kahan atka. Syntax error ho to program shuru hi nahi hota.
